name: Himatsingka Seide Limited
about: Himatsingka Seide Limited designs, develops, manufactures, distributes, and retails textile products in North America, India, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. The company offers bedding, bath, sheeting, terry towel, yarn and fiber, and drapery and upholstery solutions; and apparel solutions. It offers its products under the Disney, Himeya, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, Pimacott, Organicott, Gizacott, Homegrown Cotton, and Bellora brand names. Himatsingka Seide Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
